source: Written for Padi by the project author in the style of a middle-school science lesson and released with the repository.

blocks.text: Water on the Earth does not stay in one place. The heat of the Sun turns water in seas, rivers and lakes into vapour, which rises into the air. This is called evaporation.

As the vapour rises, it cools and turns into tiny droplets of water. This is called condensation. Millions of droplets gather to form clouds. When the droplets become heavy, they fall to the ground as rain.

rows: Water falls back to the Earth

items: Put the three stages of the water cycle in order.
